thread:
lena: tagging this thread for the SOC2 auditor ask we got via email — they want RBAC change history, KMS usage events, and proof of incident tie-ins. putting plan here.

omar: can we confirm scope window? auditor said 12 months but they later mentioned 18 months in the doc. what's the canonical ask?

auditor_bot: Auditor clarification: primary scope = last 12 months. If you can provide 12-18 months as supplemental, label as "archival". Primary deliverable = 12 months. CSV manifest + hashed bundle preferred.

dina: ok. high level deliverables we'll produce: 1) roles-principals-control-mapping.csv (include created/modified ts + actor) 2) kms-events_{keyid}.csv (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant) 3) cloudtrail_raw_export.jsonl.gz 4) audit_playback.md (chain of custody + how export was produced)

lena: for roles history, we have two sources: AWS IAM change events and k8s audit logs for RoleBindings/ClusterRoleBindings. Omar, can you take IAM and I"ll do k8s?

omar: taking IAM. example commands I'll run: ```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=iam.amazonaws.com --start-time 2025-03-01 --end-time 2026-03-01 > /tmp/iam-change-events.json
jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="UpdateRole" or .EventName=="AttachRolePolicy" or .EventName=="CreateRole")' /tmp/iam-change-events.json > /tmp/iam-role-changes.json
```

dina: for KMS we should capture both CloudTrail management and Data plane events. note: some services call KMS under the hood (e.g., RDS, EBS). we'll include a mapping table of service ARNs to high-level purpose so auditors don't mistake internal AWS key use for user actions.

infra-bot: automated notice: preparing export container. ETA ~3h for initial exports. Will create ephemeral role redacted-audit-exporter with 24h TTL and log the role creation event.

lena: people-ops: we need approval to include service account principal names in the bundle. If we must redact, auditors request a pseudonym mapping file (mapping.csv) kept as a separate encrypted artifact. Thoughts?

people-ops: we prefer pseudonymization for PII minimization. Approve mapping.csv to be encrypted and delivered separately upon signed NDA addendum. :lock:

omar: noted. i'll produce two versions: one with pseudonyms (for general delivery) and a sealed mapping (encrypted, SFTP transfer only).

lena: encryption & delivery: plan to upload evidence_bundle_v2.zip to s3://redwood-compliance/temp-audits/ with server-side encryption + bucket policy restricting GET to presigned URL only. We'll hand a 7-day presigned URL and also offer secure SFTP for the sealed mapping.

dina: Splunk query I'll include for KMS events: ```
index=cloudtrail source=aws:kms (eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant) AND requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789-abcd" | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.encryptionContext
```

lena: excellent. Also include a note that Decrypt events for envelope keys sometimes appear as "Decrypt" with service principal (e.g., ecs.amazonaws.com) — we'll annotate those.

infra-bot: exporting CloudTrail for the key via: ```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2025-03-01 --end-time 2026-03-01 --query 'Events[?contains(Resources[].ARN, `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789-abcd`)]' > /tmp/kms-decrypt-events.json
```

omar: small snag: CreateGrant events include granteePrincipal but not always the full session name. we'll capture the linked STS AssumeRole events to correlate. adding replay script to join by requestID.

lena: vuln triage tie-in: auditor asked for one incident where key misuse was investigated last year. We have IR-2025-11 where a misconfigured role allowed broader decrypt calls for a staging key. We'll include timeline, alerts, mitigation steps, and postmortem extract. Dina can you pull the redacted incident artifacts?

dina: yes. I will include: alert timeline (slack thread export), SIEM alert snapshot, CloudTrail snippet demonstrating the anomalous calls, and the remediation commit hash. Will redact sensitive traces.

people-ops: reminder to use the minimal necessary principle; redact employee IDs when possible and use pseudonyms per our policy. Also we need the signed attestation from Lena confirming exports are complete and unmodified.

lena: will sign and timestamp with PGP key. auditor_bot: confirm accepted signature types?

auditor_bot: Accepted: PGP-signed text file or an org-signed PDF. Please include signature timestamp and the key fingerprint.

omar: timeline: IAM & CloudTrail exports by EOD Tue, k8s audit slices by EOD Wed, assemble bundle Thu, upload Fri morning. People-ops approval received so sealed mapping can follow on SFTP.

infra-bot: note: some CloudTrail events older than the retention window are archived to Glacier. I checked — all requested 12 months are in standard storage.

lena: final checklist: 
- IAM role-change CSV (omar)
- k8s rolebinding history (lena)
- KMS event CSVs + Splunk snapshots (dina)
- Incident attachment package (dina)
- README with methods + hashes (lena)
- Signed attestation (lena)
- Sealed pseudonym mapping (encrypted, people-ops)
- Delivery (presigned S3 7d + optional SFTP)

dina: I'll also add an appendix describing false-positive patterns and known service-account noise so the auditor can interpret data correctly.

auditor_bot: Preference noted: include a small CSV manifest listing filenames, SHA256, and a short description field for each artifact.

lena: will produce manifest.csv as well. Thanks everyone. I'll post the presigned link here once uploaded.
